You could also say I’m too lazy to write it all out in full ----But who cares? Writing this is less about commemoration and more about forgetting—much like the monument on Red Shore in The Three-Body Problem. It’s a history and a past that aren’t exactly glorious, but they did exist. All I can do is forget—or rather, record these things before time completely beautifies and rewrites my memories. The only thing people learn from history is that they learn nothing from history, so it’s probably fair to say that history is nothing more than a list of dead people’s names. Whether it’s people or events, no matter how much we reflect or regret, we can’t go back to that time, nor can we change the established facts of what has already happened. It happened, it existed, it came to be, it was experienced—and so I’ve written them down.
